title: Automating and Scaling Behavioral Scientific Research on AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.10030v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As AI agents are increasingly deployed in complex environments, understanding their behaviors becomes critical. Yet behavioral scientific research on AI agents remains manual and labor-intensive. We introduce AEROBAT, the first multi-agent system to automate behavioral scientific research on AI agents. Given an arbitrary target behavior by its user, AEROBAT automatically executes a full pipeline of behavioral scientific research---generating hypotheses about the behavior, designing and executing controlled experiments, making behavioral assessments, analyzing the results, and writing reports. For 12 target behaviors, we used AEROBAT to generate and test 73 hypotheses: designing 1,160 controlled experiments and executing 22,954 simulation rounds in total. translated_title: 自动化与规模化AI代理的行为科学研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.10030v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：随着AI代理越来越多地部署在复杂环境中，理解其行为变得至关重要。然而，对AI代理的行为科学研究仍然依赖于手动且劳动密集的过程。我们引入了AEROBAT，这是首个多代理系统，用于自动化对AI代理的行为科学研究。给定用户指定的任意目标行为，AEROBAT自动执行行为科学研究的完整流程——生成关于该行为的假设、设计和执行受控实验、进行行为评估、分析结果并撰写报告。针对12个目标行为，我们使用AEROBAT生成并测试了73个假设：共设计了1,160个受控实验，并执行了总计22,954轮模拟。其中30个假设发现了中度至强统计证据，包括一些新颖的发现。总之，我们的结果表明，对AI代理的自动化行为科学研究是可行的。
tldr: AEROBAT是首个能自动化AI代理行为科学研究的完整流程（从假设生成到报告撰写）的多代理系统，通过大规模实验验证了其有效性，并发现了多个新颖假设。
en_tdlr: AEROBAT is the first multi-agent system that automates the full pipeline of behavioral scientific research on AI agents, from hypothesis generation to report writing, validated through large-scale experiments and discovering novel hypotheses.
